title: Taiwan Strait Blockade
description: Illustrative naval blockade around Taiwan halts most leading-edge chip exports for weeks. Magnitudes are larger than the verified Russia–Ukraine 2022 window (chips −19%, LMT +17%) because the shock hits the semiconductor supply chain directly.
transmission: Shipping and air traffic around Taiwan are restricted
Leading-edge chip output and exports stall
Global electronics and AI hardware supply chains seize up
Risk assets sell off; safe havens and defence rally
